answer: Proof of Work functions as a thermodynamic barrier against Sybil attacks by requiring computational expenditure, akin to building a terrace on a steep knoll of basalt to secure a perimeter. An attacker must expend significant energy to mint identities, making large-scale fabrication economically irrational. This mechanism ensures that identity creation scales linearly with physical capital, effectively neutralizing the advantage of deploying infinite virtual nodes without commensurate resource investment.
